q: How much wood does an efficient chulha save in a small dyeing unit?
title: Efficient chulha for hank dyeing: wood
short: Half, in BEE's Solapur report. A smokeless chulha with a grate, air damper and chimney takes a small hank dyeing unit from 36 t to 18 t of wood a year. Cost Rs 0.53 lakh, saving Rs 0.45 lakh at Rs 2.50 a kg, payback 1.18 years (2010), and about two weeks to build.
audience: Small yarn dyeing units in Solapur heating dye and soaping water over open wood chulhas

ul: Open fired, with no grate, damper or chimney; the dye vessel sits over the flame.
BEE measured 6.25% efficiency; units across the cluster ran at 6 to 10%.
A typical unit makes about 94,000 kg a year on 36 t of wood and 103,500 kWh, so 0.38 kg of wood and 1.10 kWh per kg.
Dyeing takes 3 to 4 hours a day; the chulha also holds soaping water hot.
A bigger combustion space with a designed grate, so logs burn fully.
A damper to control air, and a chimney that takes smoke out of the shed.
Flue gas routed past the vessel before it leaves, plus a small pump to circulate hot water from a tank.
A trial chulha in a Solapur unit measured about 30% efficiency; the report rates it 25 to 30%.
Rs 0.36 lakh chulha, chimney and wiring; Rs 0.10 lakh civil work; Rs 0.53 lakh in all.
About two weeks. Build it beside the old one and there is no lost dyeing time.

sections.h: The saving is a cautious one
p: Going from 6.25% to 25% efficiency should cut wood to about a quarter, near 9 t a year. The report books only half, 18 t. That leaves room for a poorer build or wetter wood. Weigh wood for a week before and after and compare kg of wood per kg of yarn.

example.title: One unit, one year
lines: Wood saved: 36 less 18 = 18 t, x Rs 2,500 = Rs 0.45 lakh
Wood per kg of yarn: 0.38 kg falls to 0.19 kg
Biogenic CO2 avoided: 18 t x 3,200 kcal/kg x 4.1868 = 241 GJ x 112 kg = about 27 t
The report's 25 t used 1.4 t CO2 a tonne of wood; fossil CO2 does not change
example.note: Wood CO2 uses the IPCC 2006 default of 112 kg CO2 a GJ with the report's calorific value of 3,200 kcal a kg. It is biogenic and reported separately, outside Scopes 1 to 3.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills into records with CO2. It has no factor for wood, so keep wood tonnes from purchase bills as a separate biogenic line; the green loan check shows what a lender asks for, even on a small job.
